summary: Our project is a PowerPoint presentation that covers spacecraft developed by NASA and its partners, their respective missions, and the start dates of these missions. With further development and the addition of more information, this could be transformed into an application or website where users can access comprehensive details about any spacecraft they select.
details: It is a PowerPoint project, and it gives information to people about the space tools NASA and it's partners made, it can improved to create an website or an app.
